propositions: A helper function absent from KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS is silently skipped during env-var scanning, leaving its env-var reads undocumented while os.environ accesses fail closed.
_gate_str_pref in _config_resolvers.py reads REBAR_GATE_REF and REBAR_GATE_SOURCE but lacks a KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS row, causing those two operator-visible vars to be missing from docs/env-vars.md.

The parameterized-shim predicate (a function whose os.environ key expression references its own parameters) is a closed, enumerable set that identifies unregistered env-read helpers reliably without false positives.
A regression test must verify that removing a KNOWN_ENV_HELPERS row for a helper that is actually used causes a loud build failure instead of silent key loss, replicating the b00f scenario.
The generator must fail closed when an env-read helper's dataflow is unresolvable, matching the fail-closed behavior already applied to os.environ attribute accesses.
